quest.title: Temaria Game
quest.description: Kid Kujirai has something to share...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #Hi, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}! I have some good stuff here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, but I'll pass.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How pitiful, being forced to do shady business at such a young age.

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: It's not what you're thinking! I wanted to ask if you wanted to play a game of Temari with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Temari?

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #It's simple, I will hide the Temari somewhere nearby. If {F#big sis}{M#big bro} can find it within the time of a Temari song, you win.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that how Temari is played?

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Huh? An awesome Big Sister adventurer taught me. And she said...

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: "Kujirai, remember. You must say, 'If you win, you'll get the good stuff.'"

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #So, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}, if you win, you'll get the good stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Good stuff! {NICKNAME}, Paimon thinks it's only right to play with children!

choices.text: But I still think Temari isn't played like this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It may be a gameplay that only local people know, let's not care about such details.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're Kid Kujirai, right? We'll play with you!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Yay!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Eh, is it too hard for you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's because Paimon was just warming up!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #{F#Big sis}{M#Big bro}, do you want to try again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Of course! {NICKNAME}, we need to show Kid Kujirai how good we are!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One more try!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Woohoo! The goal is to find the Temari within the time limit!

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: #{F#Big sis}{M#Big bro} is amazing, you found it right away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hoho, {NICKNAME} is a seasoned traveler who has been to many nations.

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: Wow! Have you also been to Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Certainly have.

dialogues.speaker: Kid Kujirai
dialogues.text: That's so cool! I heard from that Big Sister that there are many beautiful places in Mondstadt, like Stormterror's Ruins with super-duper tall towers...

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Yup! I wonder if that tower is taller, or if the Almighty Shogun's Tenshukaku is taller...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kid Kujirai, why are you out alone in the wild?

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Because when my sister was fishing, she thought I would scare the fish away, so she let me go out to play.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: Once, I met that Big Sister who was an adventurer. She saw that I was bored, so she gave me a lot of Temari, and told me to "find greedy travelers to play with."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Greedy travelers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're not greedy! We're worried! Paimon's worried that you might be bored playing by yourself!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #That's right, I think {F#big sis}{M#big bro} is really nice, I'm so happy.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alone in the wilderness...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're a kid alone in the wild, aren't you afraid of running into danger? And you even have "good stuff" on you.

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #You're really kind, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. Don't worry, that Big Sister adventurer taught me. As long as I do something to it, the Temari can turn into a bomb.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eek, that's so dangerous!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: It's not! I've blasted away a lot of bad guys, like hilichurls and slimes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're the dangerous one!

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #Oh yes, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}, if you want to play a game of Temari with other friends...

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: I'll leave a Temari here! Here are the rules...

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: When you hide a Temari, you have to hide it within the time of a Temari song. The person who is looking for it will also find it within a song's time. That will make things fair!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's so scary to think that we're actually playing with bombs...

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #Don't be scared, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. Big Sister adventurer told me "Only the bad guys will be bombed. Probably."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Probably!?"

response.speaker: Kid Kujirai
response.text: #I'm off to play somewhere else! Bye-bye, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}!
